title: The close key on a pane hides a scope pane.close could not stop
notes: pane:close in src/main/workers/worker-channels.ts:20-22 awaits pane.close and throws its answer away, so when systemctl --user stop fails, 'closed 2:3; <unit> was not stopped: ...' reaches neither the screen nor the log. A dev server the pane detached keeps its port; the next npm run dev fails with EADDRINUSE and nothing says why. From #255. Fix: log the unit not stopped as a warn, as shellIn in pane-actions.ts does, or show the answer. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/259 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/257#discussion_r4512904937
